snippet.title: Project Shadowglass Gameplay Reveal - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Gameplay for the viral '3D Pixel Art' indie Project Shadowglass was revealed during the Future Games Show Spring Showcase. It's a medieval RPG inspired by immersive sim classics like Thief and Deus Ex, and it's coming soon to PC, with a demo launching on Steam later this year.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3970690/Project_Shadowglass/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
